title: A Long Term Follow up Administration Study of L059 (Levetiracetam) in Epilepsy Patients With Partial Onset Seizures
brief_summary: This study is planned to evaluate the safety and efficacy of L059 (levetiracetam) in long-term administration in patients who completed N01020 \[NCT00160165\] or N01221 \[NCT00280696\].
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who participated in study N01221 \[NCT00280696\] and completed the evaluation period and transition period or patients who participated in study N01020 \[NCT00160615\]

Exclusion Criteria:

* Female patients during pregnancy, delivery and lactation, or suspected of pregnancy
